description: Flughafen - Flugbewegungen und Fluggastaufkommen is a dataset listed in Open Data Dortmund, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Stadt Dortmund. Flugbewegungen und Fluggastaufkommen Flughafen Dortmund Airport21 pro Jahr von 1990 - 2023. Flugbewegungen und Fluggäste gewerblich bis 1991 einschließlich Linie. Flugbewegungen und Fluggäste nicht gewerblich bis 1991 Werkverkehr und sonstiger Verkehr. Coverage: Dortmund. The portal files it under Traffic. Its keywords are Gesamtstadt, Statistisches Jahrbuch, Historie. The portal shows 34 records. The portal shows 2025-11-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Datenlizenz Deutschland - Namensnennung - Version 2.0 (https://www.govdata.de/dl-de/by-2-0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-open-data-dortmund-de-portal.
